# Target Account List

`target-account-list` · v1.0.0 · Design · Sales & Pipeline
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/target-account-list/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Which accounts fit our ICP best, and which should the team work first?

**Inputs:** The ICP and its predictive signals, plus a list of candidate accounts carrying those attributes.

**Output:** A fit-scored, tiered (A/B/C) account list with matched signals and the weighting used.

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill target-account-list`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/target-account-list/resources/score-accounts.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/target-account-list/resources/score-accounts.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON. It can read an input file you name on the command line; it reads nothing else.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- If you omit weights, the demo weights (industryMatch, sizeBand and three others) are used. Signals whose names do not match a weight are ignored, so an account can score 0 with no warning.
- Signals are true or false only. An unknown attribute counts as not matched, which pushes accounts with missing data down the list.
- The score reflects the weights, not evidence. Weights not calibrated against known-good customers produce a confident but wrong list.
- Input it doesn't recognise (an --input file with no "accounts", or a misspelled flag) returns the demo accounts, not an error, labelled with your file name. Check the result reflects your numbers.

**Review before acting:** The sales or RevOps lead justifies the weights from win-loss evidence and checks that the best existing customers land in tier A before the list routes outbound work.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/target-account-list](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/target-account-list)
